'每週日 03:00 自動備份（保留最近 ' + d.keep + ' 份）' : '尚未設定自動備份') + '｜最後備份：' + (d.last ? R(d.last.split('｜')[0]) : '無'); $('bkFolder').classList.toggle('hide', !d.folder); if (d.folder) $('bkFolder').href = 'https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/' + encodeURIComponent(d.folder); } async function loadBackup() { $('bkInfo').textContent = '讀取中…'; try { showBackup(await api('backupStatus')); } catch (e) { $('bkInfo').textContent = '讀取失敗：' + errMsg(e); } } $('btnBackup').onclick = async () => { loading(true, '備份中…'); try { showBackup(await api('backupNow')); toast('已備份資料庫'); } catch (e) { toast(errMsg(e)); } finally { loading(false); } };
